ames_spectacles.name: Spectacles
ames_spectacles.description: Wire spectacles, one arm mended with cotton. Somebody has cleaned the lenses very carefully.

tull_billhook.name: Bill-hook
tull_billhook.description: A hooked blade on an ash handle, sharp enough to be careful of. Mr Tull's.

bettany_key.name: Door Key
bettany_key.description: A plain door key on a loop of string. Mrs Bettany's spare. It opens nothing of yours.

leckie_eggs.name: Egg
leckie_eggs.description: A brown egg, still warm. Mrs Leckie's hens have not laid all week.

leckie_sack.name: Sack of Meal
leckie_sack.description: A sack of meal, the neck tied with baler twine. It is the twelfth.

kember_glove.name: Man's Glove
kember_glove.description: A man's leather glove, right hand, dry. The fingers are still curled.

gunn_bag.name: Traveller's Bag
gunn_bag.description: Canvas, with a leather strap. A shirt, a razor, a ticket for the Sunday train. No name anywhere.

hurst_fleece.name: Fleece
hurst_fleece.description: A tuft of greasy fleece with a blue raddle mark on it. Mr Hurst's.

farrant_ring.name: Wedding Ring
farrant_ring.description: A thin gold ring, worn flat on one side from being worn every day.

vosper_letter.name: Letter
vosper_letter.description: Addressed to Mrs Vosper in a young man's hand. The postmark is smudged past reading.

vosper_reply.name: Mrs Vosper's Letter
vosper_reply.description: Sealed, for her son. It is going to her sister's, who keeps them.

vosper_tin.name: Tin of Letters
vosper_tin.description: A biscuit tin, heavy with paper. Two hands, his and hers, and a string round each year.

hackett_tin.name: Tin
hackett_tin.description: A tobacco tin, rusted shut and then not. Buttons, a ration book, a photograph of a house with a roof.

tobin_scissors.name: Garden Scissors
tobin_scissors.description: Long-bladed scissors for flowers, a little sticky with sap. Mrs Tobin's.

venn_apples.name: Bag of Windfalls
venn_apples.description: Bruised apples in a paper bag, for the woodcutter. Mrs Venn picked out the worst ones and put them back.

lusk_potatoes.name: Potatoes
lusk_potatoes.description: A string bag of new potatoes, scrubbed clean before they were bagged.

arden_key.name: Clock Key
arden_key.description: A small brass key for winding a clock. Somebody will be wanting it.

voke_tea.name: Can of Tea
voke_tea.description: A tin can of tea with a wire handle, sugared the way somebody likes it.

rendle_coat.name: Good Coat
rendle_coat.description: A man's black Sunday coat, brushed and folded with care by somebody who was not his wife.

ruck_kindling.name: Kindling
ruck_kindling.description: A bundle of split kindling tied with twine, for the old lady down the road.

crow_spoons.name: Teaspoons
crow_spoons.description: Six teaspoons, no two alike, out of the crows' box. Nobody at the farm will own to them.
